summary: Repayment, deposit and recovery-menu fixes are live. Independent repayment stage/final proofs pass:1355 asset keys,363 stored encodings and273 HTTP keys; exact handler modules and desktop/mobile public UI verified. Customer can refresh/retry Vault197. plainSummary: The repayment popup fix is live, alongside the deposit and recovery-menu fixes. Independent stored-byte, served-byte and desktop/mobile checks passed, and the client can refresh and retry repaying vault 197. We have not signed or confirmed their repayment; financial recovery and reserve decisions remain separate.
